name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest open PR with a known issue first. This lets us test the tool’s real-world impact without risking interference—trade-off: slower feedback for the PR author, but we avoid breaking anything. If it works, we’ll expand to parallel runs on the oldest merged PR and the newest open PR to compare before/after behavior.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on the newest open PR tests only the latest routing and prompt—it won’t catch drift in older PRs or reveal how PR-Agent behaves with different prompt versions. Run it on the oldest merged PR first to expose edge cases from past routing changes, then expand to newer PRs once stability is proven. If PR-Agent flags no false positives or misses in the oldest PR, that settles it—otherwise, we adjust the prompts or routing before broader deployment.

name: Overhaul
